features: 2 toilets or bathrooms adapted for the disabled
inv.desc_es: Restaurante Tapería Esencia nos encontramos en la avenida Moliére número 15, rodeado de comercios, urbanizaciones, playa a escasos metros y buen clima, transportes en las inmediaciones… Cuenta con una clientela asidua desde hace años, buen ambiente y familiar. Restaurante en buenas condiciones, estancias equipadas, sistema de aire acondicionado/calefacción instalado y en funcionamiento. Cuenta con terraza exterior y toldos. Ubicado estratégicamente cerca de supermercados, institutos y colegios, centro de salud, parques, conservatorios y establecimientos en su alrededor.
inv.desc_en: Restaurante Tapería Esencia is located on Moliére Avenue 15, surrounded by shops, residential areas, a beach a few meters away, good weather, and transportation nearby. It has a regular clientele for years, a good and familiar atmosphere. The restaurant is in good condition, with equipped rooms, an installed and functioning air conditioning/heating system. It has an outdoor terrace and awnings. Strategically located near supermarkets, institutes and schools, conservatories, and establishments in its surroundings.
